author: ETAIN project; Orestis Katsamenis (scan), Felipe Ribas (mesh processing)
note: Female Drosophila melanogaster micro-CT scan from the ETAIN project; reared in the Wijnen lab at the University of Southampton, scanned by Orestis Katsamenis and processed by Felipe Ribas. The source scan geometry, orange CT material and preserved-specimen pose are retained. Uniformly scaled between head and abdomen-tip surface landmarks to the catalog’s representative 2.5 mm body length; legs, wings and bristles extend beyond that measurement. This is a stained, fixed laboratory specimen, not natural surface coloration or a living flight pose.

processing.source_model_name: Drosophila - Adult Fruit Fly - CT Scan
operations: Pack the downloadable glTF as self-contained GLB; resize original textures to at most 1024 pixels
Static scene deduplication, flatten, join, weld; decimate existing surfaces
Prune unused resources; quantize positions to 16 bits, normals to 12 bits, UVs to 14 bits; no decoder compression
Preserve source materials, geometry proportions and pose; no added geometry or labels
